results.name: Fibcaps debut in Level 3 wave 4 with their hint, and come back in L3 W6, L3 W9, L4 W5, L4 W9 and L5 W5
A credited seed makes it sneeze: it pops for nothing, and .18 s later the gust comes
A Bee Line, a Sunburst, a chain or an uncredited strike pops it quietly, with no sneeze
A sneeze blows plain buds within 74 px 26 px straight away, and leaves guardians, gifts, carried buds and foes
A sneeze never shoves a bud past dangerY - 44 - r, and never lifts one already lower
A Lullaby holds a sneeze mid-push, and it finishes after
A wave with only fibcaps left clears, and the fibcaps fizzle away
A fibcap and an ink drop at the line fizzle and cost no life
The bot never shoots a fibcap, values a puffcap beside one 20 more, and shies from a shot that skims one
Sneezes and drips play out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
Inkcaps debut in Level 3 wave 6 with their hint, and come back in L3 W8, L3 W9 and L4 W7
Drops fall at 1.5, 3.7 and 5.9 s, each its own group, from under the cap
A cap with three drops still falling skips its drip, and the schedule carries on
A drop gulps a plain seed: the seed is gone, nothing blooms, and the drop pops
A Bee Line flies through a drop and pops it; a Sunburst or a Dandelion pops it too
A drop dries up 3.2 s after it falls; one at the line fizzles alone, costing no life and leaving its cap
A Lullaby holds the drip clock and every drop
The cap is a plain 2-hit bud; any strike that reaches a drop pops it quietly
The bot forecasts each drop and never aims at one; a cap is worth 10
Mother Morel can rain drops and throw fibcaps mid-fight: make() with no index, then place()
Their art draws from cached sprites only, keeps its canvas state balanced and holds still with Animations off
foes.js never touches the seed pod and never uses Math.random
